title: P/L boundary single-crate local probes
notes: 只研究单个 crate 在 P/L 边界邻域的 push / pull 语义切换。 active_rule=P/L forceModeAt changes player action semantics； 墙、目标口袋和站位为 consumer。

cases.changedVariable: L-side front cell is open after P-side handoff
cases.title: P side pushes crate onto boundary, L side pulls it onward
cases.question: Can the same crate be pushed from the P side to the boundary-adjacent L cell, then pulled by the player after crossing into the L side?
cases.notes: Step 1 is a P-side push on the crate at x=4. Step 3 crosses from P to L. Step 6 is an L-side pull of the same crate. active_rule=P/L forceModeAt; open L front cell is the consumer.

cases.changedVariable: L-side front cell is a wall
cases.title: P side handoff succeeds, L side pull is stopped by front wall
cases.question: Does the same P-side push handoff become gated when the L-side puller's front cell is blocked?
cases.notes: Step 1 is a P-side push, step 3 crosses into L, and step 6 attempts the L-side pull. The crate remains boundary-adjacent at x=5; wall at x=7 is the consumer for the pull front-cell gate.

cases.changedVariable: after L pull, P-side push direction is wall-blocked
cases.title: L side pulls boundary crate, then P side push release fails
cases.question: After an L-side pull moves a boundary-adjacent crate, does crossing to the P side change the next crate action into a push that can be consumed by a side wall?
cases.notes: Step 1 is an L-side pull on the crate at x=5. Step 2 crosses from L to P. Step 4 is a P-side push attempt on the same crate and should be blocked by the wall at x=6. active_rule=P/L forceModeAt; side wall is consumer.

cases.changedVariable: L-side puller stand cell is also the goal pocket
cases.title: L side pull deposits the handed-off crate into a boundary pocket
cases.question: Can the P-to-L handoff be consumed by a goal pocket at the L puller's previous stand cell?
cases.notes: Step 1 is a P-side push, step 3 crosses into L, and step 6 is an L-side pull. The player stands on the goal pocket just before pulling; the crate is pulled onto that same boundary-near cell.
